analysis_cirs.ac:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Interleaved Boost Power Factor Correction Rectifier
* Auto-grounded net 0 due to GND:pin
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.ic v(VOUT)=385 v(V_COMP)=2.5 v(C_COMP1)=2.5 v(C_COMP2)=2.5
.model dmodel1 D(Rs=0.01)
.model power_nmos VDMOS(Ron=0.04 Vto=3.5 Kp=60 Cgdmax=15p Cgdmin=1p Cgs=150p)
VAC a b SIN(0 325 50)
Ra a 0 1e+07
Rb b 0 1e+07
L_EMI a a_filt 0.002
C_EMI a_filt b 4.7e-07
R_filt a_filt 0 1e+07
D1 0 a_filt dmodel1
D2 a_filt d dmodel1
D3 0 b dmodel1
D4 b d dmodel1
C_BYPASS d 0 1e-08
L1 d L1_node 0.003
VSENSE1 L1_node e1 DC 0
C_S1 e1 0 1e-09
R_S1 e1 0 1e+06
M1 e1 ctrl_gate1 0 power_nmos
R_gate1 ctrl1 ctrl_gate1 10
R_GS1 ctrl_gate1 0 100000
D5 e1 VOUT dmodel1
L2 d L2_node 0.003
VSENSE2 L2_node e2 DC 0
C_S2 e2 0 1e-09
R_S2 e2 0 1e+06
M2 e2 ctrl_gate2 0 power_nmos
R_gate2 ctrl2 ctrl_gate2 10
R_GS2 ctrl_gate2 0 100000
D6 e2 VOUT dmodel1
C1 VOUT 0 0.00047
R1 VOUT 0 400
R2 VOUT VFB 760000
R3 VFB 0 10000
* control block REF_V (const)
BREF_V VREF_NODE 0 V='5'
* control block SUM_V (sum)
BSUM_V V_ERR 0 V='V(VREF_NODE)-V(VFB)'
* control block K_V (gain)
BK_V V_RAW 0 V='100*V(V_ERR)'
* control block LIM_V (limiter)
BLIM_V V_CLAMP 0 V='min(max(V(V_RAW),0),5)'
* control block LPF_V (lowpass)
BLPF_V cb_LPF_V_d 0 V='1*V(V_CLAMP)'
RLPF_V_R cb_LPF_V_d V_COMP 1000
CLPF_V_X V_COMP 0 1e-05 IC=2.5
* control block ABS_VIN (function)
BABS_VIN V_AC_ABS 0 V='abs(V(a)-V(b))'
* control block MULT (product)
BMULT I_TARGET 0 V='0.0015*V(V_AC_ABS)*V(V_COMP)'
* control block I_SENSE1 (function)
BI_SENSE1 I_ACT1 0 V='I(VSENSE1)'
* control block SUM_C1 (sum)
BSUM_C1 C_ERR1 0 V='V(I_TARGET)-V(I_ACT1)'
* control block K_C1 (gain)
BK_C1 C_RAW1 0 V='100*V(C_ERR1)'
* control block LIM_C1 (limiter)
BLIM_C1 C_CLAMP1 0 V='min(max(V(C_RAW1),0.1),4.8)'
* control block LPF_C1 (lowpass)
BLPF_C1 cb_LPF_C1_d 0 V='1*V(C_CLAMP1)'
RLPF_C1_R cb_LPF_C1_d C_COMP1 1000
CLPF_C1_X C_COMP1 0 2.2e-08 IC=2.5
* control block I_SENSE2 (function)
BI_SENSE2 I_ACT2 0 V='I(VSENSE2)'
* control block SUM_C2 (sum)
BSUM_C2 C_ERR2 0 V='V(I_TARGET)-V(I_ACT2)'
* control block K_C2 (gain)
BK_C2 C_RAW2 0 V='100*V(C_ERR2)'
* control block LIM_C2 (limiter)
BLIM_C2 C_CLAMP2 0 V='min(max(V(C_RAW2),0.1),4.8)'
* control block LPF_C2 (lowpass)
BLPF_C2 cb_LPF_C2_d 0 V='1*V(C_CLAMP2)'
RLPF_C2_R cb_LPF_C2_d C_COMP2 1000
CLPF_C2_X C_COMP2 0 2.2e-08 IC=2.5
V_TRI1 VTRI1 0 PULSE(0 5 0 9.5e-06 5e-07 0 1e-05)
V_TRI2 VTRI2 0 PULSE(0 5 5e-06 9.5e-06 5e-07 0 1e-05)
* control block CMP1 (comparator)
BCMP1 ctrl1 0 V='0+15*(0.5*(1+tanh((V(C_COMP1)-V(VTRI1))/1e-06)))'
* control block CMP2 (comparator)
BCMP2 ctrl2 0 V='0+15*(0.5*(1+tanh((V(C_COMP2)-V(VTRI2))/1e-06)))'

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc
